browser.site_approval.question:
Allow {origin} on {node}?
An agent there asked to open this exact origin in that machine's browser. Approve keeps it allowed until someone runs `lop browser sites --revoke` on that machine; Deny refuses, and the agent won't ask about this site again. Answer from Local Operator on your own computer (the app or lop), not from a phone.
browser.site_approval.refused_unsigned: The node's browser refused this answer: it was not signed with your operator key. Nothing was approved. Answer from Local Operator on your own computer (the app or lop), not from the node or a phone.
browser.site_approval.refused_bad_signat: The node's browser refused this answer: your signature did not match the operator key installed on the node. Nothing was approved. If your operator key changed, re-run `lop browser setup --node --repair --authorised-by '<who, when>'` on the node, then let the agent ask again.
browser.site_approval.refused_expired: This site request expired before your answer reached the node's browser. The agent has to ask again.
browser.site_approval.refused_unreachabl: Your answer could not reach the node's browser. Nothing was approved; try again in a moment.
browser.site_approval.card_title: {device} asks to open a site — sign the answer on your own computer
browser.site_approval.refused_card_misma: Your computer did not sign this answer: the card's words don't match the site it would approve. Nothing was approved. If both machines run the same Local Operator version, treat this as possible tampering on the node: don't retry, and tell whoever runs that agent. Otherwise update both and let the agent ask again.
browser.site_approval.refused_no_approve: The node's browser has no operator key to check answers against, so it cannot approve sites. Nothing was approved. Install your operator anchor on the node, then run `lop browser setup --node --repair --authorised-by '<who, when>'` there.
browser.site_approval.card_title_lapsed: this site request timed out — nothing was allowed; the agent has to ask again
browser.site_approval.refused_node_name_: Your computer did not sign this answer: the card names the machine "{claimed}", but your mesh knows that device as "{known}". Nothing was approved. Treat this as possible tampering on that machine: don't retry, and tell whoever runs that agent.
browser.site_approval.refused_old_signer: This device can't answer a node's site request. Answer it from Local Operator on your own computer (the app or lop), updated to the release that added signed site approvals or later — not from a phone or the node itself.
browser.site_approval.sites_help: list the sites this machine's browser has allowed or denied, or remove one with --revoke
browser.site_approval.sites_revoke_help: remove the stored decision (a grant or a denial) for this exact origin
browser.site_approval.sites_denied: Denied by the operator (no new card is raised for these):
browser.site_approval.sites_broad: Broad grants (cover a whole domain or host):
browser.site_approval.sites_allow_all: Every site is allowed: the extension's all-sites switch is on.
browser.site_approval.sites_none: No site decisions are stored in this machine's browser.
browser.site_approval.sites_revoke_hint: Remove one with: lop browser sites --revoke ORIGIN
browser.site_approval.sites_revoked: Removed the stored decision for {origin}. An agent has to ask the operator again before opening it.
browser.site_approval.sites_revoke_nothi: Nothing was stored for {origin}, so nothing was removed.
browser.site_approval.sites_still_broad: A broad grant may still cover {origin}: {grants}.
browser.site_approval.sites_bad_origin: {origin} is not an http or https origin.
browser.site_approval.sites_unreachable: Could not reach this machine's browser: {detail}. Check it with `lop browser status`.
